source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Optimize antibiotic selection, dosing, and duration to improve outcomes while reducing the development of antibiotic resistance","B":"Increasing antibiotic use broadly across essentially every client admitted to the facility, regardless of clinical need or indication","C":"Eliminating antibiotic use altogether across essentially every unit within the facility, even for clients who genuinely need treatment","D":"Applying mainly to outpatient clinics and pharmacies, with fairly little relevance to inpatient hospital antibiotic use overall"}}
source_row.rationale: Antibiotic stewardship programs aim to optimize antibiotic selection, dosing, and duration to improve clinical outcomes while reducing the development of antibiotic resistance and other adverse consequences of antibiotic overuse or misuse.
source_row.source_name: CDC — Core Elements of Hospital Antibiotic Stewardship Programs
